I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-team message to confirm the Thornbury Cloth Co. signed order form is due 21 December. He said no action was needed, so I did nothing else. His message is already on record because channel messages are saved automatically.

Before replying, I searched the brain for anything about that deadline. I found nothing on Thornbury Cloth Co., so nothing contradicts what he said. That search was keyword-only, so it may have missed records worded differently.
